title: Japan's GMO Internet investigating leaked customer data
excerpt: Japan internet giant GMO is verifying customer data posted online by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.
body_html:
Japanese internet company GMO Internet is currently verifying data that was posted online by suspected hackers. The incident follows a breach affecting a cloud service used by the company.

The organization announced it is looking into the alleged customer information to confirm its authenticity and assess the impact of the unauthorized access.
